svg.title: The spoke's only way out, and the symptom
svg.desc: snet-app has default outbound access off, so vm-app's internet traffic follows rt-spoke's route default-via-nva, 0.0.0.0/0 to vm-nva, over the peering to the hub, where vm-nva has default outbound access to the internet. The symptom: from vm-app, curl and apt-get update time out, while ping and ssh to vm-nva work and names still resolve.
